question: India has the longest international land border with _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India shares the **largest border with Bangladesh** and the length is around **4096 km.**
 
• India has approx**. 15100 km of land border **and a **coastline of 7,516.6 km** including island territories, with its neighboring countries. 
 
• This **makes it the fifth-longest land border in the world.**
 
• The border between India and Bangladesh includes the following lengths in each state: 
 
 
• **Assam: 262 kilometers**
 
• **Tripura: 856 kilometers**
 
• **Mizoram: 318 kilometers**
 
• **Meghalaya: 443 kilometers**
 
• **West Bengal: 2,217 kilometers**
